content.value: In a typical bi-prism arrangement of (b/a)=20 and for sodium light (λ=5890Å),one obtain a fringe width of 0.1cm; here b and a are the distance between the bi-prism and the screen, the slit and the bi-prism respectively.(Assumingμ=1.52). Calculate the angle α’ (refracting angle of the bi-prism).
